notes: Repeated HQ/R&D runs early often re-saw the same cards; after losing Yog.0 the Runner clicked for credits for roughly ten turns up to 41 credits with a full grip, never rebuilding a rig or contesting the advanced remotes the Corp scored from.
Short game: sensible central ice turn 1, Viper and Pup rezzed at good moments and the Runner walked into Pup with a two-card grip; little Corp decision-making to judge.

Reached 6 points fast but then spent many turns at 0 credits running unprotected R&D three or four times a turn, mostly re-accessing the same top card, never building economy and letting Oaktown and Hostile Takeover score.
Left HQ unprotected early (Beale stolen) and put GFI behind a lone non-ETR Turnpike (stolen); later scored well behind Resistor and wasted 6 credits rezzing SanSan City Grid in Archives.
Steady R&D pressure through Pop-up Window won the game, but the Runner stayed very poor, set Security Testing on Archives each turn without cashing it, and sat on tags for many turns.

Good Closed Accounts timing and a solid scoring remote, but despite 15+ credits for many turns it never added ice to R&D (only Pop-up Window) under constant R&D pressure, played Psychographics for nothing, and clicked for credits while rich.
Reasonable HQ pressure with Bukhgalter and Inside Job, sensible Amina install and good Leela bounces; a few slow credit clicks and a facecheck into Hagen were the only oddities.

Installed nothing but Daily Casts and clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 47 credits with a full grip, never contesting the remotes where Geothermal Fracking, Oaktown and Project Atlas were scored.
Economy stayed poor all game, so HQ's Tollbooth couldn't be rezzed when Beale was stolen and R&D had only Pop-up Window against repeated R&D runs; remote play was otherwise reasonable.
Good Biotic Labor fast-advance and well-timed Eli scoring, with AstroScript then used to finish; credits ran very thin late but the Corp never exposed an agenda.
Facing a totally passive Runner, the Corp took 27 turns to win and spent many clicks advancing ice, clicking for credits and playing IPOs at 25+ credits instead of installing and scoring agendas.

Installed Atman at strength 0 and facechecked ice with it; after already eating one Snare! the Runner ran another naked remote with a three-card grip, ended tagged on two cards and was flatlined by Scorched Earth.
Good Blue Sun bounce economy and scoring behind Chiyashi and a three-ice remote; the only waste was Punitive Counterstrike when it could do 0 damage, and SSL Endorsement was stolen from HQ early.

Ran an open R&D four times turn 1, mostly re-seeing the same card, then clicked for credits for five straight turns up to 26 credits without contesting Server 1, where a broke Corp scored behind a single trace-4 Resistor that money could have beaten.

Built a decent rig and economy with Temujin, but couldn't handle Tollbooth, and with the Corp at 5 points and broke it ran HQ twice instead of the fresh card in Server 2, which was the winning agenda.
Hoarded Breaking News and GFI in an HQ guarded only by Pop-up Window while clicking for credits up to 17 and discarding, never installing an agenda; the Runner took 7 points from HQ in five turns.

Survived three Scorched Earths only by refilling to five cards while leaving tags up when it could have cleared them, and facechecked ice early, but it won by hitting the remotes efficiently with Cerberus.

Built a three-ice remote and then clicked for credits for about ten turns up to 45 credits, discarding each turn and never installing the GFI and Corporate Sales Teams in hand, while R&D sat behind a single Pup.
Solid asset economy, tag tempo from Hard-Hitting News and clean two-turn scoring in an iced remote; minor oddities were Mumbad Virtual Tour in R&D root and never punishing the tags.

Never installed a breaker or used its credits; three times it left an advanced card in Server 3 alone (behind Tour Guide, which it had already passed) while running Archives/R&D or clicking for credits, and each of those agendas was scored.
